title: spec:changed
description: `watchTargets`: `spec:changed` for the data folder and Lathe's check rows.

title: spec:changed(check.jsonl)
description: `watchTargets`: `spec:changed` when a file of check rows changes, Lathe's `lathe/data/check.jsonl` or the product's own in its data folder.

title: lathe:navigate
description: the lathe:navigate event and popstate; delivery in process

title: change
description: `change` in usePageTabs: when a change leaves another tab active, it opens that tab's address and gives the window that tab's history (app/src/views/tabHistory.ts), in the same call.

title: ThemeState.chosen
description: `choose` sets ThemeState.chosen; the effect that follows applies the theme and keeps it (applyTheme, themeStore.save).

title: ThemeState.mode
description: `setMode` sets ThemeState.mode; the effect that follows applies it and keeps it (applyTheme, themeStore.save).

title: ThemeState.custom
description: `duplicate` and `importFile` add the new theme to ThemeState.custom; the effect that follows keeps it (themeStore.save).

title: openFolder
description: `openFolder`: once the folder checks, it adds it to the recent folders (rememberRecent) and opens its window, whose server startApp starts, in the same call.

title: closed
description: Electron's `closed` event on a product window: its handler stops the window's server and forgets the window.
